steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each placement's guarantee window is placed on the timeline from its start date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 replacement is due with no decision

findings.title: Replacement due with no decision
findings.fix: Decide the replacement under the agreement

findings.title: Guarantee end date not computed from the agreement
findings.fix: Recompute the end date from the agreement

outcome.notChecked: Whether the placed candidate is performing.
